scope: All sixteen v5 support cases and labels retained, two repetitions, under the unchanged v7 arithmetic and strict-output protocol. Historical regression, not independent blind evaluation or isolated causal comparison.
stop_rule: Complete the fixed 32-candidate schedule using extraction then semantic review; at most one source-existence contradiction recheck per candidate. Declared provider configuration failures stop the batch. No transport retries, output repair, tuning or replacing evidence.
review_basis: Expected statuses fixed from declared Observation boundaries before any model call; labels and case ids are never passed to the model.
